goal: Play a full round: put out fires, rescue everyone, refill water
summary: The playtester tried to grab gear from two racks, then walked to the Mission Board to start a round. Every ProximityPrompt interaction returned 'held, not triggered', so the round never left the Lobby and no fires, rescues or refills were attempted. The probe showed no server errors, so the blocker is either the prompts or the interact harness.

bugs.title: Mission Board 'Pick a call' prompt never triggers, so the round cannot start
bugs.evidence: Step 6: interact on MissionBoard returned 'held, not triggered' at about 7.5 studs, inside the 16-stud range. Step 8: the retry with hold 0.5 gave the same result. The playtester's reports say RoundState stayed Lobby. No fires or rescues were ever spawned, which blocked the whole goal. The harness may be at fault, since all prompts fail the same way, but nothing in the trace shows that.

bugs.title: Gear Rack prompts (Grab Axe / Grab Extinguisher) do not trigger when in range
bugs.evidence: Step 1: GearRack1 'Grab Axe' returned 'held, not triggered' at about 7.8 studs. Step 3: the same result at about 3 studs. Step 4: GearRack2 'Grab Extinguisher' gave the same result. The Carrying attribute stayed empty in every observation, and the playtester's reports say the HUD showed 'empty hands'.
